behavioral_effects: The tests manifest is filed where its authority says it belongs: curated, hand-maintained review judgment, inside the curated ownership rule, no longer promising a regeneration that does not exist

The catalog description now says the coverage floors mirror backend/pyproject.toml and frontend/vitest.config.ts and are updated with them, so the duplication is declared rather than implied to be extracted
compatibility_impact: The tests manifest is now governance/manifests/curated/tests.json with provenance.method curated, catalogued as manifest-curated / authority curated / update manual. Both code readers (checks/process.py, graph/algorithms.py) and the internal schema binding follow it. Historical change records that cite the old path are history and were left untouched. The generated directory no longer contains a file that sync cannot rebuild - except ai-runtime.json and data-stores.json, which have the same shape and were deliberately not moved under this reason.
follow_up: ai-runtime.json and data-stores.json are hand-authored in manifests/generated with the same missing renderer; move each under its own reason or give it an extractor
A small check that curated tests.json coverage_floors equal fail_under in backend/pyproject.toml and coverage.thresholds in frontend/vitest.config.ts would close the drift the record above admits
limitations: A renderer was not written: suites and invariant_coverage are judgment, not extraction, and a half-rendered file would split one document across two authorities. The coverage_floors values are therefore still hand-mirrored and can drift from pyproject/vitest without a check catching it (the coverage-floor-does-not-regress rule is still phase-5)
reason: governance/manifests/generated/tests.json is hand-authored - its suites and invariant_coverage sections are review judgment about which invariant has a dedicated test - but it sat in the generated directory, was catalogued as authority=generated/update=sync, and pipeline.render_all never rendered it, so the location promised a regeneration that did not exist and the reproducibility check could not see it. Filing it under manifests/curated with provenance method curated makes its authority match its origin, keeps it inside the curated ownership rule, and leaves the generated directory meaning what it says.
rollback: git revert (the rename and the six repointings are one commit); then make governance-sync.
security_impact: None. A file moved between two governed directories; the read-surface still lists it; no permission or exposure change.
summary: Move the hand-authored tests manifest from manifests/generated to manifests/curated
